# Mod Settings

Tie your mod's variables to settings, and you can craft a more dynamic experience around each player's preferences.

</figure>

A setting takes two steps. Declare it, so it shows on that page. Then read it in your events or script, where it changes the game.

## Declaring settings

Declare settings in the .c5se, or on `#!@` lines of the .c5m. Each setting is `newsetting`, one kind ([`onoff`](#onoff), [`choice`](#choice) or [`key`](#key)), a `default` and a `label`, in any order. Text lengths and the number of options: [Limits](limits.md#mod-settings).

### newsetting &lt;name&gt; { #newsetting .command data-toc-label="newsetting" data-added="2.0" }

Creates a setting.

- **name:** The word your events and scripts read the setting by: letters, digits and `_`, starting with a letter. Each name once per mod; capitals don't count.

=== ".c5m"

    ```c5m
    #!@newsetting eye_awakens
    ```

=== ".c5se"

    ```c5se
    newsetting eye_awakens
    ```

### onoff { #onoff .command data-toc-label="onoff" data-added="2.0" }

Adds a single on/off checkmark. An event with `+setting <name>` happens only while it's checked, and a script reads true or false.

=== ".c5m"

    ```c5m
    #!@onoff
    ```

=== ".c5se"

    ```c5se
    onoff
    ```

### choice { #choice .command data-toc-label="choice" data-added="2.0" }

Adds a list of 2 to 8 options, where the player picks one. An event with `+setting <name> <option>` happens only while the player has that option picked, and a script reads the option's number.

=== ".c5m"

    ```c5m
    #!@choice
    ```

=== ".c5se"

    ```c5se
    choice
    ```

### key { #key .command data-toc-label="key" data-added="2.0" }

Adds a hotkey, where the player picks which keyboard key does something in your mod. Your Lua script reads the key with `coe5.setting` and gives it its job, such as a shortcut for one of the game's actions (`coe5.rebindKey`).

=== ".c5m"

    ```c5m
    #!@key
    ```

=== ".c5se"

    ```c5se
    key
    ```

### default &lt;value&gt; { #default .command data-toc-label="default" data-added="2.0" }

Sets the setting's starting value.

- **value:** 0 or 1 for `onoff`; an option's number for `choice`; a key in double quotes for `key`.

??? note "Key names"

    - A letter, digit or punctuation key is its character: `"y"`, `"7"`, `"?"`. Capitals count: `"B"` is shift+b.
    - Named keys: Space, Tab, Enter, Esc, Backspace, Delete, Home, End, PgUp, PgDn, Up, Down, Left, Right, F1 to F12.
    - Combinations: `ctrl+`, `alt+` or `ctrl+shift+` and a key: `"ctrl+i"`, `"alt+s"`, `"ctrl+F5"`.

=== ".c5m"

    On:

    ```c5m
    #!@default 1
    ```

    Or a key:

    ```c5m
    #!@default "p"
    ```

=== ".c5se"

    On:

    ```c5se
    default 1
    ```

    Or a key:

    ```c5se
    default "p"
    ```

### label "&lt;text&gt;" { #label .command data-toc-label="label" data-added="2.0" }

Sets the setting's text on the page, or a sub-page's name after `newsettingpage`.

=== ".c5m"

    ```c5m
    #!@label "The Eye of Sauron awakens"
    ```

=== ".c5se"

    ```c5se
    label "The Eye of Sauron awakens"
    ```

### option &lt;number&gt; "&lt;text&gt;" { #option .command data-toc-label="option" data-added="2.0" }

Adds an option to a `choice`.

- **number:** The option's number, from 0, with no gaps.
- **text:** The option's text.

=== ".c5m"

    ```c5m
    #!@option 1 "On turn 100"
    ```

=== ".c5se"

    ```c5se
    option 1 "On turn 100"
    ```

### optiontip &lt;number&gt; "&lt;text&gt;" { #optiontip .command data-toc-label="optiontip" data-added="2.0" }

Sets an option's hover text.

- **number:** The number of the `option` it describes.

=== ".c5m"

    ```c5m
    #!@optiontip 2 "A short game: Mordor marches early."
    ```

=== ".c5se"

    ```c5se
    optiontip 2 "A short game: Mordor marches early."
    ```

### tip "&lt;text&gt;" { #tip .command data-toc-label="tip" data-added="2.0" }

Sets the hover text of an `onoff` or `key` setting.

=== ".c5m"

    ```c5m
    #!@tip "Every turn of spring, every player gains 5 fire."
    ```

=== ".c5se"

    ```c5se
    tip "Every turn of spring, every player gains 5 fire."
    ```

### restart { #restart .command data-toc-label="restart" data-added="2.0" }

Asks the player to restart the game when they leave your page with the setting changed.

=== ".c5m"

    ```c5m
    #!@restart
    ```

=== ".c5se"

    ```c5se
    restart
    ```

### group "&lt;word&gt;" { #group .command data-toc-label="group" data-added="2.0" }

Stops the `key` settings of one group in your mod from holding the same key.

=== ".c5m"

    ```c5m
    #!@group "ring"
    ```

=== ".c5se"

    ```c5se
    group "ring"
    ```

### fixed { #fixed .command data-toc-label="fixed" data-added="2.0" }

Stops the player changing a `key` setting.

=== ".c5m"

    ```c5m
    #!@fixed
    ```

=== ".c5se"

    ```c5se
    fixed
    ```

### parent &lt;name&gt; <span class="new-badge">New</span> { #parent .command data-toc-label="parent" data-added="3.4" }

Puts an `onoff` or `key` setting under an `onoff` setting of your mod. Use it when you have multiple options you want attached to a single on/off, like a switch for endgame scenarios with each scenario under it. While the parent is off, the settings under it are greyed out and read as off, a key as no key. The player's own picks come back when the parent is on again.

- **name:** The parent's name. It comes before this setting, on the same page, and has no `parent` of its own.

=== ".c5m"

    ```c5m
    #!@parent endgame
    ```

=== ".c5se"

    ```c5se
    parent endgame
    ```

![Endgame scenarios on, with its six scenarios under it](../assets/mod-settings-parent-on.png)

![Endgame scenarios off: the six scenarios greyed out](../assets/mod-settings-parent-off.png)

### newsettingheader "&lt;title&gt;" { #newsettingheader .command data-toc-label="newsettingheader" data-added="2.0" }

Puts the `onoff` and `key` settings after it in a box with this title, up to the next `newsettingheader` or `choice`. Follow it with an `onoff` or `key` setting that has no `parent`.

=== ".c5m"

    ```c5m
    #!@newsettingheader "Sorcery and Speed"
    ```

=== ".c5se"

    ```c5se
    newsettingheader "Sorcery and Speed"
    ```

### newsettingpage &lt;name&gt; { #newsettingpage .command data-toc-label="newsettingpage" data-added="2.0" }

Puts the settings after it on a sub-page, up to the next `newsettingpage`. Give it a `label`.

- **name:** The page's name: 1 to 32 letters, digits and `_`, starting with a letter. Players see its `label` instead.

=== ".c5m"

    ```c5m
    #!@newsettingpage keys
    #!@label "Keys"
    ```

=== ".c5se"

    ```c5se
    newsettingpage keys
    label "Keys"
    ```

### Example settings { #example }

=== ".c5m"

    ```c5m
    #!@newsetting eye_awakens
    #!@choice
    #!@default 1
    #!@label "The Eye of Sauron awakens"
    #!@option 0 "Never"
    #!@optiontip 0 "Sauron sleeps: Mordor never marches."
    #!@option 1 "On turn 100"
    #!@option 2 "On turn 60"
    #!@optiontip 2 "A short game: Mordor marches early."

    #!@newsettingheader "Endgame"

    #!@newsetting endgame
    #!@onoff
    #!@default 1
    #!@label "Endgame scenarios"
    #!@tip "Six threats, from turn 100 to 160."

    #!@newsetting nine_ride
    #!@onoff
    #!@default 1
    #!@label "The Nine ride"
    #!@tip "Turn 100: the Witch-king and eight Ebon Knights near your citadel."
    #!@parent endgame

    #!@newsetting isengard_marches
    #!@onoff
    #!@default 1
    #!@label "Isengard marches"
    #!@tip "Turn 110: an Ogre Chief, 40 Goblins and 6 Trolls near your citadel."
    #!@parent endgame

    #!@newsetting corsairs_land
    #!@onoff
    #!@default 1
    #!@label "The Corsairs of Umbar"
    #!@tip "Turn 120: a Pirate Captain and 30 Pirates near your citadel."
    #!@parent endgame

    #!@newsetting wolves_hunt
    #!@onoff
    #!@default 1
    #!@label "The Wolves of Angmar"
    #!@tip "Turn 130: a Dire Wolf and 30 Wolves near your citadel."
    #!@parent endgame

    #!@newsetting barrow_wights
    #!@onoff
    #!@default 1
    #!@label "The Barrow-wights"
    #!@tip "Turn 140: a Wight King and 20 Wights near your citadel."
    #!@parent endgame

    #!@newsetting ettenmoor_trolls
    #!@onoff
    #!@default 1
    #!@label "The Trolls of the Ettenmoors"
    #!@tip "Turn 160: a Troll King and 10 Trolls near your citadel."
    #!@parent endgame

    #!@newsettingheader "Sorcery and Speed"

    #!@newsetting istari_sorcery
    #!@onoff
    #!@default 1
    #!@label "Istari sorcery"
    #!@tip "Every turn of spring, every player gains 5 fire."

    #!@newsetting istari_might
    #!@onoff
    #!@default 0
    #!@label "Istari might"
    #!@tip "Every turn of spring, every player gains 5 more fire."

    #!@newsetting swift_cavalry
    #!@onoff
    #!@default 0
    #!@label "Rohirrim move 1 square further"
    #!@restart

    #!@newsettingpage keys
    #!@label "Keys"

    #!@newsetting ring_next
    #!@key
    #!@default "n"
    #!@label "Next Ring-bearer"
    #!@group "ring"

    #!@newsetting ring_previous
    #!@key
    #!@default "b"
    #!@label "Previous Ring-bearer"
    #!@group "ring"

    #!@newsetting close_map
    #!@key
    #!@default "x"
    #!@label "Close the map of Middle-earth"
    #!@fixed
    ```

=== ".c5se"

    ```c5se
    newsetting eye_awakens
    choice
    default 1
    label "The Eye of Sauron awakens"
    option 0 "Never"
    optiontip 0 "Sauron sleeps: Mordor never marches."
    option 1 "On turn 100"
    option 2 "On turn 60"
    optiontip 2 "A short game: Mordor marches early."

    newsettingheader "Endgame"

    newsetting endgame
    onoff
    default 1
    label "Endgame scenarios"
    tip "Six threats, from turn 100 to 160."

    newsetting nine_ride
    onoff
    default 1
    label "The Nine ride"
    tip "Turn 100: the Witch-king and eight Ebon Knights near your citadel."
    parent endgame

    newsetting isengard_marches
    onoff
    default 1
    label "Isengard marches"
    tip "Turn 110: an Ogre Chief, 40 Goblins and 6 Trolls near your citadel."
    parent endgame

    newsetting corsairs_land
    onoff
    default 1
    label "The Corsairs of Umbar"
    tip "Turn 120: a Pirate Captain and 30 Pirates near your citadel."
    parent endgame

    newsetting wolves_hunt
    onoff
    default 1
    label "The Wolves of Angmar"
    tip "Turn 130: a Dire Wolf and 30 Wolves near your citadel."
    parent endgame

    newsetting barrow_wights
    onoff
    default 1
    label "The Barrow-wights"
    tip "Turn 140: a Wight King and 20 Wights near your citadel."
    parent endgame

    newsetting ettenmoor_trolls
    onoff
    default 1
    label "The Trolls of the Ettenmoors"
    tip "Turn 160: a Troll King and 10 Trolls near your citadel."
    parent endgame

    newsettingheader "Sorcery and Speed"

    newsetting istari_sorcery
    onoff
    default 1
    label "Istari sorcery"
    tip "Every turn of spring, every player gains 5 fire."

    newsetting istari_might
    onoff
    default 0
    label "Istari might"
    tip "Every turn of spring, every player gains 5 more fire."

    newsetting swift_cavalry
    onoff
    default 0
    label "Rohirrim move 1 square further"
    restart

    newsettingpage keys
    label "Keys"

    newsetting ring_next
    key
    default "n"
    label "Next Ring-bearer"
    group "ring"

    newsetting ring_previous
    key
    default "b"
    label "Previous Ring-bearer"
    group "ring"

    newsetting close_map
    key
    default "x"
    label "Close the map of Middle-earth"
    fixed
    ```

## Reading settings

Events read a setting with [`+setting`](#setting), with no script needed. A Lua script reads one with `coe5.setting("<name>")`.

!!! warning
    In network games, no event with `+setting` or `-setting` happens.

### +setting &lt;name&gt; [index] { #setting .command data-toc-label="+setting" data-added="1.0" }

Makes an event happen only while the setting is on, or while a `key` setting has a key. `-setting` is the opposite. Goes in an event, in the .c5se or the .c5m.

- **name:** The name on the setting's `newsetting` line.
- **index:** For a `choice`, the option the player picked; for a `key`, the key it holds.

=== ".c5m"

    While it is on:

    ```c5m
    #!@+setting istari_sorcery
    ```

    Or while a choice has option 1:

    ```c5m
    #!@+setting eye_awakens 1
    ```

=== ".c5se"

    While it is on:

    ```c5se
    +setting istari_sorcery
    ```

    Or while a choice has option 1:

    ```c5se
    +setting eye_awakens 1
    ```

### Example events { #example-events }

The events that read the example settings above:

=== ".c5m"

    ```c5m
    playerevent
    +turnnbr 100
    #!@+setting eye_awakens 1
    message -2 "The Eye of Sauron opens. Mordor marches on the free peoples."
    endevent

    playerevent
    +turnnbr 60
    #!@+setting eye_awakens 2
    message -2 "The Eye of Sauron opens. Mordor marches on the free peoples."
    endevent

    playerevent
    +turnnbr 100
    #!@+setting nine_ride
    message -2 "The Nine ride out of Minas Morgul."
    scatterloc 3
    newunits 28 "c*Witch-king of Angmar & 8*Ebon Knight"
    endevent

    playerevent
    +turnnbr 110
    #!@+setting isengard_marches
    message -2 "Saruman's host marches out of Isengard."
    scatterloc 3
    newunits 28 "c*Ogre Chief & 40*Goblin & 6*Troll"
    endevent

    playerevent
    +turnnbr 120
    #!@+setting corsairs_land
    message -2 "The Corsairs of Umbar come ashore."
    scatterloc 3
    newunits 28 "c*Pirate Captain & 30*Pirate"
    endevent

    playerevent
    +turnnbr 130
    #!@+setting wolves_hunt
    message -2 "The wolves of Angmar hunt in the dark."
    scatterloc 3
    newunits 28 "c*Dire Wolf & 30*Wolf"
    endevent

    playerevent
    +turnnbr 140
    #!@+setting barrow_wights
    message -2 "The Barrow-wights leave their mounds."
    scatterloc 3
    newunits 28 "c*Wight King & 20*Wight"
    endevent

    playerevent
    +turnnbr 160
    #!@+setting ettenmoor_trolls
    message -2 "Trolls come down from the Ettenmoors."
    scatterloc 3
    newunits 28 "c*Troll King & 10*Troll"
    endevent

    playerevent
    +season 3
    #!@+setting istari_sorcery
    addresources -2 7 5
    endevent

    playerevent
    +season 3
    #!@+setting istari_sorcery
    #!@+setting istari_might
    addresources -2 7 5
    endevent
    ```

=== ".c5se"

    ```c5se

    +setting eye_awakens 1

    +setting eye_awakens 2
    message -2 "The Eye of Sauron opens. Mordor marches on the free peoples."

    playerevent

    endevent

    playerevent
    +turnnbr 130

    message -2 "The wolves of Angmar hunt in the dark."

    endevent
    ```
